faq.q: Which is bigger, the Pershing 46 or Astondoa 40?
faq.a: The Pershing 46 is larger at 14 metres (46 feet) compared to the Astondoa 40 at 12.5 metres (40 feet). The Pershing also carries up to 10 passengers, while the Astondoa takes 9.
The Pershing 46 is a performance-oriented sport cruiser with higher top speeds, typically exceeding 35 knots. The Astondoa 40 is a comfortable family cruiser with a cruising speed around 22 knots.

faq.q: What is the price difference between the two?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 has fixed rates: €749 for 2 hours, €1,499 for 4 hours, and €2,299 for 8 hours, all inclusive. The Pershing 46 requires a price request via WhatsApp, and is generally more expensive due to its size and performance.

faq.q: Which boat is better for a large group?
faq.a: The Pershing 46 can take 10 passengers, one more than the Astondoa 40. However, the Astondoa 40 offers a more spacious cockpit and saloon, making it more comfortable for groups that want to lounge.

faq.q: Do both boats depart from the same marina?
faq.a: Yes, both the Pershing 46 and Astondoa 40 depart from Puerto Banús, the premier marina in Marbella. This gives you direct access to the best spots along the Costa del Sol.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Both charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs.

faq.q: Which boat is better for a sunset cruise?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 is ideal for sunset cruises thanks to its wide, comfortable seating and large sun pads. The Pershing 46 is better for those who want a sporty, fast ride to reach a sunset spot quickly.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food on either boat?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food on both boats. The included snacks are light, so feel free to bring a picnic or order catering in advance.

data.body_html:
Choosing between the Pershing 46 and the Astondoa 40 for your Marbella charter in 2032? Both are premium vessels departing from Puerto Banús, but they serve different vibes. The Pershing 46 is a 14-metre sport cruiser built for speed, while the Astondoa 40 is a 12.5-metre family-friendly motor yacht that prioritises comfort and value. This comparison covers size, capacity, price, and the best use case for each boat, so you can make an informed decision for your day on the Costa del Sol.

Size and Capacity

The Pershing 46 measures 14 metres (46 feet) and can carry up to 10 passengers. The Astondoa 40 is slightly shorter at 12.5 metres (40 feet) with a maximum of 9 guests. While the Pershing has one extra seat, the Astondoa’s beamier hull and clever layout often feel more spacious, especially in the saloon and aft cockpit. For a group of 8–9, the Astondoa 40 is perfectly sized; for 10, the Pershing 46 is your only option in this comparison.

Performance and Speed

The Pershing 46 is a performance yacht, capable of top speeds over 35 knots thanks to its deep-V hull and powerful engines. It’s built for thrill-seekers who want to feel the wind. The Astondoa 40 cruises comfortably at 22 knots, making it better for leisurely coastal hops. If your priority is a fast run to Cala del Faro or a quick dash to Estepona, choose the Pershing. If you prefer a relaxed pace with time to soak up the sun, the Astondoa is the smarter pick.

Pricing and Inclusions

The Astondoa 40 has transparent, fixed pricing: €749 for 2 hours, €1,499 for 4 hours, and €2,299 for 8 hours. All inclusive: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. The Pershing 46’s price is on request via WhatsApp and typically higher, reflecting its larger size and sportier pedigree. Both include the same standard inclusions, so the main difference is the upfront cost. For budget certainty, the Astondoa 40 wins.

Best Use Cases

  • Pershing 46: Ideal for a group of 10 wanting a sporty, fast-paced charter. Perfect for stag dos, corporate events, or anyone who loves speed. Great for reaching far spots like Sotogrande quickly.
  • Astondoa 40: Best for families, couples, or small groups of up to 9 who value comfort, space, and value. Excellent for sunset cruises, relaxed lunch trips, or a day exploring Cabopino and Cala Cortés.

Which One Should You Choose?

If you want the fastest ride and need capacity for 10, go with the Pershing 46. If you prefer a more spacious, cost-effective option for up to 9 guests, the Astondoa 40 is the better choice. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include the same all-inclusive package. For a deeper dive into all our options, visit our boat rental Marbella hub.
